name: The Iron Masquerade
source:
The night was going well. Then they locked the doors...

You are a detective who just wanted to enjoy the masquerade ball. Unfortunately, someone else had other plans and killed the [REDACTED]. Now it's up to you to solve the case before the police station opens at 6 AM.

[From [url=https://ult-colt.itch.io/the-iron-masquerade]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
晚上过得很顺利。然后他们就锁上了门…

你是一名只想享受化装舞会的侦探。不幸的是，其他人有其他计划并杀死了[REDACTED]。现在你需要在警察局早上6点开门之前破案。

[来自[url=https://ult-colt.itch.io/the-iron-masquerade]itch.io[/url]]
